description: This file defines the StreamFactoryInterface interface within the Psr\Http\Message namespace. It declares methods for creating stream objects from strings, files, and resources, which are essential for HTTP message handling in a PSR-7 compliant library.

classes.name: StreamFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for creating stream objects from various sources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string content, typically using a temporary resource.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing file, with specified opening mode, supporting error handling for file access issues.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing PHP resource, which must be readable and potentially writable.
